add_definitions(
    -D_WINE)

spec2def(comdlg32.dll comdlg32.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

if(DLL_EXPORT_VERSION GREATER_EQUAL 0x600)
    add_idl_reg_objects(comdlg32 registry comdlg32_classes.idl)
endif()

# comdlg32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/comdlg32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(comdlg32_shims OBJECT autocomp.cpp cdlg32.c colordlg.c filedlg.c filedlg31.c filedlgbrowser.c finddlg.c fontdlg.c itemdlg.c printdlg.c)
target_link_libraries(comdlg32_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload oldnames libshell32 libshlwapi libcomctl32 libwinspool libuser32 libgdi32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(comdlg32_shims) # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE and CONST_VTABLE
add_cargo_module(comdlg32 comdlg32-cargo comdlg32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS comdlg32_shims psdk $<TARGET_NAME_IF_EXISTS:comdlg32_r> uuid_sources)
